purpose: Widen the web-entry firewall rule from the single verifying laptop (plus its Tailscale address) to the whole LAN subnet, then read the effective rule and the listener isolation back from a fresh SSH session. Sanitized: names, addresses, ports and HTTP status codes only.

firewall_rule.name: UWorkers-CLAWSTA80-Web-13001
readback_commands: Get-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'UWorkers-CLAWSTA80-Web-13001' | Select-Object DisplayName, Enabled, Direction, Action, Profile

not_verified: a second LAN device beyond the verifying client PC: the subnet-wide scope is proven by the rule readback, not a per-device matrix
company-network reachability and its own LAN CIDR
service_lifecycle: read-only checks; the running deployment was not restarted, redeployed or reconfigured for this evidence
